# IPTV For Firestick USA

> Firestick IPTV in the United States. Soft WhatsApp setup, 7 MOTION player, private 24-hour trial. No public playlist. No invented star ratings.

IPTV For Firestick USA (https://iptvforfirestickusa.com) helps US households start IPTV on Amazon Firestick. Access stays in chat. We do not publish a public playlist file. We do not invent star ratings or review counts.

## Start

- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447307410512
- Prefill: Firestick IPTV USA + trial. City + device.
- Free trial page: https://iptvforfirestickusa.com/free-trial

## 7 MOTION path

1. Message WhatsApp with your US city and that you have a Firestick.
2. Start the private 24-hour trial — no card.
3. Prep the stick (5 GHz Wi-Fi or a short Ethernet adapter).
4. Install 7 MOTION — the player we prefer on Firestick.
5. Enter the chat details. Do not hunt a public playlist.
6. Check a night at home on your own TV.
7. Choose a duration on WhatsApp only if it holds.
